pinreg_r4: r4 (2026-10-15): die master is pin-registered (PR=1, tools/qwen_split/d2d_pinreg_gen.py): every functional port has one flop at its pin, placed FIRM at the pin by recipe-2 io_flop_at_pins; fixes qkd r1 EARLY_FAIL_SETUP (-434 ps, all boundary paths) and qfd r1 TT -79 / FF -32.6.

pin_regs.reason: RTL is already pin-registered: d2d_pinreg_gen.py PR=1 wraps qkd_d2d_static_core with exactly one flop per functional port (FIRM at the pin via io_flop_at_pins); the link calendar is compiled --pinreg; a second synthesized pin register would add +1 cycle per port with no timing purpose

structural_change: Actual native33 failure repaired structurally: kept run_p takes sameD/reset/edge as running; phase advance no longer shares32-load high-pointer predicate. Zero added edges; full real miter and native gate required.
reset_role_review: Only por_n/rst_n reset sequential state. host_link_reset_req is a PR-registered protocol request; phy_rst_n/fwd_link_rst_n are PR-registered protocol outputs. Restrict the compatibility regex to literal reset roles, preserving their data pin flops and landing exactly the two real resets. This fixes pre-synthesis OT_PIN_REGS refusal, not a timing failure.
